title: Vinyl Earned Two And A Half Times More Than CDs
hook: Vinyl won the physical comeback while streaming kept the real crown.
closing: Vinyl is booming, but physical music now survives as a premium niche.
question: What record would you buy?

segments.say: Vinyl revenue reached about two and a half times CD revenue, turning the comeback into a clear physical-market win.
Vinyl sold 41 million albums, so the revenue lead also appeared in how many records people bought.
Streaming still captured 84 percent of recorded-music revenue, making vinyl the physical winner inside a much smaller market.
